attempts.summary: Created an SSH host CA on node1, signed the host's ed25519 key into a certificate, configured sshd to present it, and verified a client trusting only the CA (no pinned host key) connects without prompting. Then performed the mandatory single-node restart: captured pre-restart boot_id/service health, issued a native reboot, polled until exec was available again, confirmed the boot_id changed, and re-verified sshd health and the CA-based trust behavior post-restart.
